jobs.title: Technology Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description:
Dodge & Cox is investing in the future of its Technology organization. As the firm continues to build and develop its technology capabilities, we are strengthening how we attract, develop, and support our people; deepening leadership, performance management, and team development practices to meet the demands of an evolving technology landscape.
To support this work, we are looking to hire a Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP). The HRBP will serve as the primary people partner to the Chief Technology Officer and the Technology leadership team, with responsibility for talent strategy, organizational design, performance management practices, leadership development, employee relations, and the cultural integration of an evolving employee population across multiple locations.
This is a hands-on, strategic, and highly visible role. The HRBP will work alongside Technology leadership to translate the technology team development roadmap into concrete people outcomes, while partnering closely with the broader Human Capital, Recruiting, Legal, and Compliance teams. The role reports to the Director of Human Capital & Administration.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Partnership & Organizational Design
- Serve as the trusted Human Capital advisor to the Chief Technology Officer and Technology leadership team on all people matters.

- Partner on team design, role architecture, workforce planning, and recruiting.

- Translate the Technology strategy into clear, measurable people priorities, and report progress against a defined scorecard.

- Anticipate organizational risks, continuity, culture, capability, and compliance, and proactively shape interventions.

Change Management & Workforce Insights
- Apply structured change management practices to support the multi-year Technology Team strategic plan, including stakeholder communication, manager enablement, and adoption planning.

- Use people data (attrition, engagement, hiring funnel, span of control, internal mobility)to identify risks, surface insights, and inform leadership decisions.

- Build feedback mechanisms that allow the firm to learn quickly and adapt as the Technology organization evolves.

Talent Acquisition & Onboarding
- Partner with the Recruiting team and external search partners on the hiring strategy.

- Support hiring managers on interview design, candidate assessment, and inclusive hiring practices.

- Co-own the onboarding program for new Technology hires, including mentor pairing, milestone check-ins, and early-tenure feedback loops.

- Support deliberate knowledge transfer when contractor scopes transition to employee roles, ensuring documentation, pair-working, and runbook standards are met.

Team & Leadership Development
- Shape and steward a structured management development program for Technology managers — built in-house or in partnership with external providers — covering team development, performance conversations, delegation, feedback, and operating rhythms.

- Lead an annual team health assessment including qualitative 360 feedback from stakeholders and peers and partner with leaders to act on results.

- Coach Technology managers and senior individual contributors on difficult conversations, conflict resolution, and team effectiveness.

- Support succession planning and high-potential development across the Technology organization.

Performance Management
- Partner with Technology leaders on the performance review cycle.

- Coach and train managers on effective feedback delivery, performance documentation, and the day-to-day practices that support fair and well-supported performance decisions.

- Advise managers on navigating complex performance situations, in partnership with senior Human Capital leadership and Legal.

- Help shape and operate the job architecture for Technology roles, including leveling, scope, and competency frameworks.

Employee Relations
- Serve as a senior point of contact for sensitive employee relations matters within the Technology organization, exercising sound judgment and discretion.

- Advise managers on policy interpretation, conflict resolution, and employee concerns.

- Identify themes and patterns in employee relations matters and recommend systemic improvements.

Cultural Integration
- Champion the Dodge & Cox culture within the Technology organization, helping leaders translate the firm's values — including collaboration and team decision-making, individual accountability, and continuous improvement — into everyday team practices and decisions.

- Design team-building, on-site, and connection rituals that preserve Dodge & Cox culture across locations.

Qualifications
Required
Experience & Knowledge
- Ten or more years of Human Resources experience, with at least five years in an HR Business Partner or equivalent strategic HR role.

- Demonstrated experience partnering with technology, engineering, or product leadership in a complex, knowledge-intensive organization.

- Track record of leading meaningful organizational change—workforce model shifts, geographic expansions, or comparable transformations.

- Deep working knowledge of performance management, job architecture, talent calibration, and employee relations.

- Strong coaching and influencing skills, with the credibility and judgment to advise senior leaders and challenge thoughtfully.

- Comfort using people data and analytics to inform decisions and tell a clear story to leadership.

- Sound understanding of employment law and HR compliance, including multi-state considerations.

- Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to operate with discretion and handle highly sensitive information.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

Competencies
- Genuine energy and passion for people, talent development, and helping individuals and teams grow.

- Strong ownership mindset, with the drive and accountability to see meaningful work through from idea to impact.

- Genuinely collaborative working style, with the ability to build trust and operate effectively across functions, levels, and locations.

- Sound judgment and discretion, with a track record of handling sensitive information and complex interpersonal situations with care.

- Intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn the business—including the technology domain—deeply enough to be a credible partner to leaders.

- Comfort operating with ambiguity and building from the ground up, with a bias toward action and follow-through.

- Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to navigate shifting priorities and changing circumstances while maintaining focus on what matters most.

- Demonstrated ability to influence and coach senior leaders without formal authority, including the willingness to challenge respectfully.

Preferred
- Experience in financial services, asset management, or another highly regulated industry.

- Familiarity with technology talent markets in the San Francisco Bay Area and Boston.

- Experience supporting AI, cloud, data, or platform engineering teams.

- SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or comparable Human Resources certification.

The salary range for this position is $165-190k.

jobs.title: 2027 Trading Strategy Associate
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Trading Strategy Associate will be an integral member of the Equity Trading team at Dodge & Cox. The Equity Trading team is responsible for implementing tactical and investment decisions in markets globally. The team is comprised of creative problem solvers who not only execute trades but also work closely with investment committee members; research analysts; and portfolio implementation, trade analytics, and strategy teams to develop strategic approaches to sourcing liquidity.

The Trading Strategy Associate will be expected to integrate into a teamwork-driven culture that values cooperation and communication in its decision-making processes. This is a 2-to-4-year position with the potential for longer-term employment.

Key Responsibilities
- Research the properties of trading algorithms and perform in-depth analyses of global market micro-structure
- Analyze market and trading data and create frameworks to evaluate existing trading strategies and tools
- Advise and consult with execution traders on execution strategy and tactics
- Develop pre-trade, intra-trade, and post-trade execution analysis for trading in Equity and FX markets
- Develop and automate execution performance measurement framework and reporting
- Develop and implement trading signals/models to help improve execution performance
- Leverage AI and machine learning techniques, including deep learning and reinforcement learning, to enhance trading signal research, execution strategies, and analytics
- Help to develop and improve trading workflows, including assessment of third-party vendor tools and third-party data
- Perform ad-hoc analyses/participate in projects as required by internal clients

Ideal Candidate Profile
- Highly organized and detail-oriented, with outstanding time management skills
- Flexible, reliable, proactive, and service-oriented
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to work effectively and contribute in a team environment, as well as independently
- Passionate about contributing to the growth of a developing and evolving function of the business

Qualifications
- Master's degree in financial engineering, data science, or other quantitative field
- 2 years’ relevant work experience at a financial institution preferred, or post-undergraduate internship experience that demonstrates exceptional potential
- Knowledge of and/or exposure to trading algorithm design and analysis
- Knowledge of and/or exposure to trade executions and/or execution performance analysis
- Basic knowledge of global market microstructure
- Strong statistical and programming foundation using Python, R, MATLAB, C++ or similar languages
- Knowledge of AI and machine learning methods, with demonstrated depth in deep learning (e.g., neural network architectures, model training and evaluation) and reinforcement learning (e.g., policy optimization, sequential decision-making) and their application to trading problems
- Familiarity with modern AI tools and frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, LLM-based tools) to accelerate research, prototyping, and workflow automation
- Basic knowledge of data management using SQL and other database tools
- Willingness and flexibility to cover different markets and trading hours
- CFA or demonstrated interest in obtaining the CFA designation

jobs.title: Fund Treasury Analyst
jobs.description:
Dodge & Cox is seeking a fund treasury analyst to join our Fund Treasury team. This role primarily supports fund accounting, financial and regulatory reporting, and NAV calculation oversight functions. In addition, the analyst will assist with U.S. mutual fund-level tax compliance and reporting, as well as security-level taxation compliance and reporting across all our mutual funds. We seek an individual with a solid foundation in fund accounting or mutual fund taxation. A successful candidate will be a proactive, detail-oriented problem-solver, who thrives in a collaborative environment.

Primary responsibilities:
- Perform fund accounting key controls/processes, including review of the Funds’ daily NAV calculations and oversight of custodian/fund accounting agent
- Oversee security-level tax liabilities (e.g., dividend income withholding tax, foreign capital gains tax) for all our mutual funds, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations and associated reporting obligations across markets; prepare documentation to claim tax entitlements; leverage third party tools and resources to collaborate across teams and service providers to assess changes in markets
- Analyze tax implications of fund investments and transactions in the highly specialized areas of regulated investment companies (IRC Subchapter M)
- Review tax provisions, financial statement tax disclosures, federal and state returns, shareholder tax reporting, and fund distribution calculations for our U.S. mutual funds; liaise with tax administrators and tax accountants
- Assist with fund administration functions including regulatory reporting, financial reporting, annual audit support, board of trustees reporting
- Identify and implement opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and strengthen internal controls

Qualifications:
- A minimum of 5 years of relevant fund accounting experience and/or regulated investment company (RIC) tax experience
- Strong in Microsoft Excel; ability to manage and analyze large data sets
- Excellent analytical, problem solving and data management skills
- Highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive
- Effective written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact across teams and with external partners
- Commitment to integrity, ethics, and a collegial, collaborative work environment

jobs.title: Senior Emerging Markets Research Associate
jobs.description:
Role Overview
Dodge & Cox is seeking an experienced, highly skilled Research Associate to join our team. The Senior Emerging Markets Research Associate will work with senior analysts and members of the Dodge & Cox investment team in identifying, researching and advocating for emerging market companies.
Dodge & Cox's well-established reputation provides us with unparalleled access to corporate management teams. We regularly host Fortune Global 500 executives at our offices in San Francisco.

This is a two-to-three-year position, after which most individuals enroll in business school or pursue a career in investing.

Key Responsibilities

- Researching emerging market companies that may be attractive investments

- Monitoring portfolio investments, competitors, and industry developments

- Building and maintaining financial and valuation models

- Engaging with company management teams, industry experts, and sell-side analysts as requested

- Creating investment-related presentation materials

Ideal Candidate Profile

- High levels of academic and professional achievement and leadership ability

- Attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Intellectually curious with a genuine appetite for understanding businesses and industries in depth

- Comfortable working across time zones and cultures, and able to build productive relationships with external research partners

- Detail-oriented and conscientious, producing analysis of exceptional quality

- Able to work independently and exercise sound judgment with limited supervision

Qualifications

jobs.title: AI Governance Program Manager
jobs.description:
Dodge & Cox is looking for an AI Governance Program Manager to keep the firm’s cross-functional AI governance work organized, coordinated, and moving. This role sits within the AI Governance pillar, one of four pillars in the firm's AI operating model, with contributing cross-functional members from InfoSec, Legal, Risk, and Compliance, which protects the firm and our clients through proactive management of AI policy and procedures, regulatory alignment, and risk management.
Reporting to the AI Governance Pillar lead, this person will be responsible for driving progress across the pillar’s many workstreams: coordinating Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Information Security contributors; tracking deliverables and deadlines; and facilitating the processes that allow the firm to make timely, well-informed, well-documented decisions about AI use so the firm can deepen AI adoption across every function with confidence. This is one of two new roles in the pillar, alongside an AI Information Security Lead, and offers a real opportunity to shape governance processes as the firm's AI operating model matures.
Key Responsibilities
- Manage governance workstreams end-to-end: track deliverables, deadlines, dependencies, and risks across the pillar’s policy and risk management initiatives
- Coordinate governance reviews across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Information Security, and other stakeholders, ensuring outcomes are documented and issues are escalated through appropriate channels;
- Facilitate the pillar’s decision-making process by preparing clear materials, ensuring the right stakeholders provide input, and driving discussions to resolution
- Manage the policy-to-deployment review process for new AI tools, integrations, and capabilities in coordination with the Infrastructure pillar
- Facilitate updates to policies, standards, procedures, and governance frameworks by identifying recurring governance issues and cross-functional decision patterns
- Prepare governance updates and materials for the AI Steering Group
- Maintain project documentation, status reporting, and a clear record of decisions

Qualifications
Required
- 5+ years in program or project management, with experience supporting governance- or risk-oriented initiatives
- Experience designing, implementing, or maturing governance processes, operating models, or control frameworks.
- Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders across legal, compliance, risk, and/or information security functions
- Ability to navigate ambiguity, identify recurring patterns, and translate complex issues into governance solutions.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to distill large amounts of information and frame communications for varied audience needs
- High emotional intelligence with demonstrated ability to build trust, influence without authority, facilitate consensus, and drive commitment to outcomes
- Strong organizational skills and the ability to oversee multiple projects, tasks, and interdependencies effectively
- Demonstrated ability to proactively manage timelines and resources and mitigates risks

Preferred
- Experience in regulated compliance-intensive environment, preferably asset management or financial services
- Technical familiarity with AI concepts and tools and working knowledge of information security principles, data governance, and common control frameworks sufficient to facilitate informed governance discussions and evaluate whether deliverables meet governance requirements. Note: deep subject matter expertise is not required, as the pillar’s Legal, Compliance, Risk, and InfoSec members provide that depth
- Exposure to AI governance, technology policy, or technology risk management
- Program or project management credentials (e.g., PMP, PgMP)
- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to AI

Dodge & Cox is looking to hire a junior team member for its Quantitative Analysis and Data Science (QUADS) team. This is an investment-side role in which the investment associate will work directly with senior members of our team to assist with quantitative research in our Fixed Income department. This position would be a good fit for those pursuing a longer-term career in financial data science and/or fixed income investing. The work will be leveraged across the Fixed Income department and will provide the Investment Associate with exposure to investment professionals and senior management across the firm. This is a two-to-four-year position after which most individuals pursue higher education or careers in investment management.

- Answering data-driven research questions posed by our investment committees
- Running analytics to support investment decision-making and risk management (risk models, portfolio simulations)
- Building and improving asset allocation models
- Developing and maintaining code to power dashboards and visualizations

jobs.title: 2027 Fixed Income Investment Associate
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Investment Associate will play an important role in Dodge & Cox's fixed income investment process and be part of a lean investment team, with a primary emphasis on credit investing, but opportunities to work alongside investment professionals across the firm.

The Associate will develop a comprehensive set of skills centered on credit investing, work directly with senior investment professionals, and have the opportunity to meet with management teams representing the largest companies around the world. The bulk of training occurs on the job, supplemented by formal sessions on an interim basis. This person will also gain exposure to firm-wide investment ideas through ongoing research and portfolio management meetings.

Investment Associate projects are wide-ranging. As a member of the fixed income investment team, this person will support senior professionals in all aspects of the investment process: identifying new opportunities, conducting research and analysis, advocating to investment committees, and managing portfolio exposures.

This is a two-to-four-year position, after which candidates generally pursue other professional opportunities or enroll in business school. Research Associates have gone on to attend business schools including Stanford, Harvard, Wharton, The University of Chicago, and INSEAD.

Key Responsibilities
- Analyze domestic and international corporate and government borrowers, and assist in the preparation of research reports; processes include data collection, fundamental due diligence, financial analysis, and assessment of valuation and potential returns
- Use data to construct and maintain portfolio analysis tools
- Update and maintain research reports on existing portfolio investments
- Prepare client presentation exhibits and reports

- A commitment to high-quality performance and strong attention to detail

- An ability to collaborate effectively within a team-oriented environment

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

Qualifications
- One to two years of related work experience or an undergraduate experience that demonstrates exceptional potential
- B.A. or B.S. degree and an excellent academic record

- Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including experience with financial modeling

- Coursework or demonstrated experience in corporate finance or valuation is a plus
